## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

  business growth.

  Embeddable Satellite Transmitters allow developers to rapidly design, develop and manufacture

  you to transmit data with a solution that is scalable, and requires no additional infrastructure.

crew welfare.

Safety

Safety is in our DNA – established in 1979 by the International Maritime Organization (IMO) to
deliver dependable satellite safety communications.

just yet, narrowband remains a cost-efficient solution to keep your vessel connected.

# Iridium PNT ASIC

Our first-to-market chip enables alternative positioning, navigation, and timing anywhere on Earth.

[Discover Iridium PNT ASIC][40]

## Protect Critical Operations

Help maintain trusted positioning and timing for the people, assets, and systems that matter most,
even when GNSS signals can't be trusted.

[Develop with us][41]

### Prepare for a more resilient future

Equip next-generation products with trusted technology that helps support safer, more secure, and
more reliable operations across industries.

[Cityscape featuring telecommunication endpoints]

### Build with confidence

Bring assured PNT capabilities to market faster with a solution designed to simplify development and
reduce integration effort.

[Two Multiethnic Male Data Center System Administrators and IT Specialists Talk, Use Laptop.
Information Technology Engineers work on Cyber Security Network Protection in Cloud Computing Server
Farm.]

### Maximize design flexibility

Integrate Iridium PNT into even the most space-constrained products with an 8x8mm ASIC designed to
fit where larger solutions can't.

[Iridium PNT ASIC]

## Full Ownership, No Ongoing Commitments

When you purchase a domain from DomainMarket.com, it becomes 100% yours. After the transfer, you'll
manage the domain directly through your registrar, and we no longer have access and you have no
ongoing fees with us.

### Our Purchase Process

Step 1 Complete Your Purchase

Once you purchase the domain, you'll immediately receive an email confirmation from us.

Step 2 Payment Verification

We verify payment and buyer details before initiating the transfer.

If paying by credit card or PayPal: Transfer instructions sent within 3–7 business days

Or via wire transfer: Transfer instructions sent within 24 hours after wire clears

Step 3 Transfer Your Domain

You choose how the domain is transferred:

Transfer to another registrar: Use the provided authorization code. Per ICANN rules, this can take
up to 5 days.

Or stay with current registrar: Ususally GoDaddy, we move the domain directly into your account. No
5-day wait.

Step 4 Transfer Complete

Once the domain is transferred it is officially yours in all respects. Congratulations. You have
just taken control of a world class domain brand that you can benefit from perpetually.

You now own the domain 100%

### Instant Credibility

Premium domains signal an established business that customers can trust.

### Better Search Rankings

Keyword-rich domains give you an edge in search results from day one.

### Long-Term Investment

Premium domains appreciate over time — they're an asset, not just an expense.

## Satellite Solutions for Mission-Critical Connectivity

Apollo Satellite Communications is your trusted partner for secure, reliable, and high-performance
satellite communication solutions. We provide businesses, government agencies, and professionals
with industry-leading satellite voice and data services, ensuring seamless connectivity in the most
remote and challenging environments—on land, at sea, and in the air.

From enterprise-grade satellite networks to rugged mobile devices, our solutions empower industries
such as defense, maritime, energy, emergency response, and remote operations. Whether you need
global asset tracking, remote workforce connectivity, or mission-critical communications, Apollo
Satellite delivers the technology and expertise to keep you connected anywhere on the planet.

regardless of your location.

## The SpaceMobile Network

Our BlueBird satellites provide full broadband directly to standard smartphones without specialized
hardware or phone modifications. Make video calls, browse the web, and use your apps at 4G and 5G
speeds from anywhere on Earth.

##### Frequently Asked Questions

Discover answers to frequently asked questions about our company, satellites, and services.

[Read All FAQs][39]
What is AST SpaceMobile’s mission?

AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network accessible
directly by standard, unmodified mobile phones. Our mission is to eliminate the connectivity gaps
faced by today’s nearly six billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions
who remain unconnected around the world.

Why do we need space-based connectivity?

Reliable mobile coverage has become essential to modern life – not only for daily, personal
communication, but also for accessing critical services such as remote education, healthcare, and
jobs. Yet, more than [87% of the world’s surface][40] is out of reach from traditional cell
towers.  

AST SpaceMobile is working to close that gap. Our space-based technology is designed to connect the
unconnected, bringing broadband access directly to standard mobile phones everywhere, even in the
most remote areas. By democratizing access to the digital economy, we are not just connecting
devices, we are connecting people a [[AST SpaceMobile]][1]

# The world's only dedicated satellite networks

Flexible, resilient, high-speed connectivity from GEO for global customers
[
OUR GEO SATELLITE FOR TAIWAN
][9]

### Five GEO satellites in orbit today, many more launching soon.

Before Astranis, satellites came in one of two types: small sats for low earth orbit, or behemoth
megasats for high orbits. At Astranis we built a new class of satellite— small, powerful
GEO satellites for high orbits with the latest in digital processing technology. Astranis has more
than 10 satellites on contract for customers around the world, representing more than $1 billion of
satellite services sold.
TRUSTED BY

### High orbits matter

Geostationary orbit (GEO) is the most valuable real estate in the solar system, with over $15
billion of satellites launched to GEO annually, and Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) is home to
mission-critical space systems like GPS. Why?

### High orbits mean dedicated assets.

The higher you go, the fewer satellites you need to provide constant service — all the way to GEO,
where a single satellite can carry out a 24/7 mission on its own.
[
Thaicom selects Astranis to build and operate THAICOM-9.
][10]

### High orbits offer critical services.

The device in your pocket (or hand) is currently listening to a constellation of high-orbit
satellites — GPS. We’re using our high-orbit satellites to enhance GPS resiliency alongside Space
Force, ensuring continued delivery of position, navigation, and timing transmissions to warfighters
and the public at large.
[
Astranis selected to design next-gen Resilient GPS satellites.
][11]

### High orbits are the ultimate high ground.

Space is a contested domain, and Low-Earth Orbit is at risk of catastrophic loss. High orbits offer
greater security: by staying above the fray, they are less vulnerable to ground-based threats and
offer more decision time to react to contingencies, whether incidental or intentional.
[
Astranis announces new contract for US government mission.
][12]

### Building advanced GEO satellites for high orbits is hard

Astranis has surmounted some incredible engineering challenges to bring this product to market. The
radiation environment beyond Low Earth Orbit would fry any normal computer hardware in days or
hours. This requires GEO satellites to be radiation-hardened, which traditionally drives cost up and
timelines out. Launching to higher orbits is also considerably harder. Medium-class rockets can’t
take you all the way there, so high-orbit satellites usually need expensive and complex on-board
propulsion systems.
In-House Testing
In-House Manufacturing
In-House Machining

### Small, radiation-hardened spacecraft were thought impossible.
### Until we built them.

### Proudly Made in America

We design, manufacture, test, and operate our GEO satellites at our global headquarters at Historic
Pier 70 in California. Our facility previously built warships during the World Wars. Now it builds
spaceships.

### High orbits matter

Geostationary orbit (GEO) is the most valuable real estate in the solar system, with over $15
billion of satellites launched to GEO annually, and Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) is home to
mission-critical space systems like GPS. Why?

### High orbits mean dedicated assets.

The higher you go, the fewer satellites you need to provide constant service — all the way to GEO,
where a single satellite can carry out a 24/7 mission on its own.
[
Thaicom selects Astranis to build and operate THAICOM-9.
][10]

### High orbits offer critical services.

The device in your pocket (or hand) is currently listening to a constellation of high-orbit
satellites — GPS. We’re using our high-orbit satellites to enhance GPS resiliency alongside Space
Force, ensuring continued delivery of position, navigation, and timing transmissions to warfighters
and the public at large.
[
Astranis selected to design next-gen Resilient GPS satellites.
][11]

### High orbits are the ultimate high ground.

Space is a contested domain, and Low-Earth Orbit is at risk of catastrophic loss. High orbits offer
greater security: by staying above the fray, they are less vulnerable to ground-based threats and
offer more decision time to react to contingencies, whether incidental or intentional.
[
Astranis announces new contract for US government mission.
][12]

### Building advanced GEO satellites for high orbits is hard

Astranis has surmounted some incredible engineering challenges to bring this product to market. The
radiation environment beyond Low Earth Orbit would fry any normal computer hardware in days or
hours. This requires GEO satellites to be radiation-hardened, which traditionally drives cost up and
timelines out. Launching to higher orbits is also considerably harder. Medium-class rockets can’t
take you all the way there, so high-orbit satellites usually need expensive and complex on-board
propulsion systems.

### Until we built them.

We design, manufacture, test, and operate our GEO satellites at our global headquarters at Historic
Pier 70 in California. Our facility previously built warships during the World Wars. Now it builds
spaceships.

# **Welcome to Dan Technologies**

### ENABLING A NETWORK-CONNECTED MEDIA ENVIRONMENT

Our business is enabling customers to create, systemise and deliver digital content to their viewers
and listeners.

At Dan Technologies, we strive to connect businesses with their core audiences, wherever they may
be.

Our services, workflow systems and support infrastructure are enabling the broadcast and media
industry and other associated sectors to do better business, increase efficiency, improve their
users’ experience and capture new opportunities.

Technology is the core of our business. Dan Technologies’ engineers, researchers and operational
teams around the world are continually working on what’s next in broadcast and electronic media. On
our website you will find out more about our company, our vision, advances in technology and the
ways that we can help you grow your business.

## About Globalsat Group

Globalsat US delivers secure, resilient satellite connectivity for mission-critical operations
across North America. Our US affiliate, authorized by the FCC since 2017, enables frictionless
logistics, local partnerships, and rapid response—proven during Hurricane Maria relief in Puerto
Rico. We design multi-orbit, hybrid networks that integrate satellite and terrestrial links for IoT,
PTT, maritime, aviation, and business continuity when it matters most.

[Learn more →][72]

/ MARKETS

## [Utilities][73]

Optimize your operations and manage your assets, on a global scale.

/ MARKETS

## [IoT][74]

To monitor and control assets and infrastructure in remote locations globally, robust, reliable, and
resilient always ready solutions.

/ MARKETS

## [Business Continuity][75]

Globalsat ensures resilient connectivity during disasters, outages, or cyberattacks. Our satellite
failover systems, SDWAN, VPNs, and mobile office kits keep critical operations online—trusted by
emergency, IT, and healthcare teams to stay connected when it matters most.

/ MARKETS

## [Transport & Logistics][76]

For transport managers, the safety and security of their fleet is paramount. Versatile voice and
data solutions keeping fleets connected anywhere.

/ MARKETS

## [Mining][77]

Globalsat delivers reliable satellite communications for mining operations in remote and challenging
environments. From fleet tracking to real-time monitoring and worker safety, our multi-network
solutions ensure continuous connectivity that keeps production moving and teams protected—no matter
how extreme the conditions.

/ MARKETS

## [Agriculture & Forestry][78]

In agriculture and forestry, the increasing competition to get the most out of often diminishing
resources. That means going farther, working harder and communicating better than anyone else.

/ MARKETS

## [Federal Government / Military][79]

Globalsat delivers secure, compliant, and mission-ready communications for government and defense
operations.With experience in federal procurement, cybersecurity, and tactical satellite systems, we
enable national resilience, interagency coordination, and connectivity in the most demanding
environments.

/ MARKETS

## [Maritime][80]

Keeping ships connected, efficient and safe at sea, anywhere.

/ MARKETS

## [SLED (State, Local, and Education)][81]

Globalsat provides reliable, scalable connectivity for state, local, and education agencies. From
public safety and city infrastructure to rural schools, our satellite and IoT solutions ensure
communication, continuity, and resilience where it’s needed most.

/ MARKETS

## [Aviation][82]

From critical missions to executive travel, helicopters and business jets require dependable
in-flight connectivity.

/ MARKETS

  ### Satellite Organization

**The International Mobile Satellite Organization** (IMSO) is an intergovernmental organization
established in 1976 by the International Maritime Organization ([IMO][26]), a United Nations
specialized agency. IMSO contributes to the safety and security of seafarers and passengers around
the world by providing oversight of the satellite providers of the Global Maritime Distress and
Safety System (GMDSS) and as the Co-ordinator for the Long-Range Identification and Tracking of
Ships (LRIT) system, both established by IMO under the International Convention for the Safety of
Life at Sea ([SOLAS][27]).

[Learn more][28]

## Our Work

### GMDSS Oversight

IMSO is the oversight body of the satellite communications elements of the Global Maritime Distress
and Safety System (GMDSS) established by IMO and designed to provide a worldwide system for
automated emergency signal communication for ships at sea. IMSO ensures that the provision of
maritime mobile satellite communications services (currently provided by [Inmarsat Ltd][29] and
[Iridium Ltd][30]) meets the criteria set up by IMO.

[Learn more][31]
[Feedback on GMDSS Services][32]

### LRIT Co-ordinator

IMSO is the Co-ordinator of the Long-Range Identification and Tracking (LRIT) system of ships
established by IMO and designed to collect and distribute position information received from around
40,000 ships worldwide that are subject to IMO’s International Convention for the Safety of Life at
Sea ([SOLAS][33]). IMSO ensures that the system operates properly by undertaking annual audits of
all elements of the LRIT system across 123 countries.

[Learn more][34]

### Other Activities

IMSO represents its Member States’ interests in relation to the GMDSS and LRIT in global
policy-making fora to ensure that these vital systems remain relevant to changing priorities. It
also provides expertise and advice on matters relating to IMSO’s mandate at the international and
national level to enhance safety and security at sea as well as search and rescue capabilities and
standard-setting activities concerning satellite communication systems oversight.

[Learn more][35]

## Member States

**IMSO has currently 112 Member States.**
Membership in the Organization is open to all States, subject to the provisions contained in the
Convention on the International Mobile Satellite Organization.

[Learn more][36]

  ### International Mobile
  ### Satellite Organization

**The International Mobile Satellite Organization** (IMSO) is an intergovernmental organization
established in 1976 by the International Maritime Organization ([IMO][26]), a United Nations
specialized agency. IMSO contributes to the safety and security of seafarers and passengers around
the world by providing oversight of the satellite providers of the Global Maritime Distress and
Safety System (GMDSS) and as the Co-ordinator for the Long-Range Identification and Tracking of
Ships (LRIT) system, both established by IMO under the International Convention for the Safety of
Life at Sea ([SOLAS][27]).

[Learn more][28]

## Our Work

### GMDSS Oversight

IMSO is the oversight body of the satellite communications elements of the Global Maritime Distress
and Safety System (GMDSS) established by IMO and designed to provide a worldwide system for
automated emergency signal communication for ships at sea. IMSO ensures that the provision of
maritime mobile satellite communications services (currently provided by [Inmarsat Ltd][29] and
[Iridium Ltd][30]) meets the criteria set up by IMO.

[Learn more][31]
[Feedback on GMDSS Services][32]

### LRIT Co-ordinator

IMSO is the Co-ordinator of the Long-Range Identification and Tracking (LRIT) system of ships
established by IMO and designed to collect and distribute position information received from around
40,000 ships worldwide that are subject to IMO’s International Convention for the Safety of Life at
Sea ([SOLAS][33]). IMSO ensures that the system operates properly by undertaking annual audits of
all elements of the LRIT system across 123 countries.

[Learn more][34]

### Other Activities

IMSO represents its Member States’ interests in relation to the GMDSS and LRIT in global
policy-making fora to ensure that these vital systems remain relevant to changing priorities. It
also provides expertise and advice on matters relating to IMSO’s mandate at the international and
national level to enhance safety and security at sea as well as search and rescue capabilities and
standard-setting activities concerning satellite communication systems oversight.

[Learn more][35]

## Member States

**IMSO has currently 112 Member States.**
Membership in the Organization is open to all States, subject to the provisions contained in the
Convention on the International Mobile Satellite Organization.

[Learn more][36]

## About Inmarsat Government

**We are the world leader in global, mobile satellite communications, providing the industry’s most
extensive portfolio of global narrowband and wideband connectivity services and managed network
solutions to users on land, at sea and in the air. Backed by almost 40 years of experience, we
deliver the world’s most reliable satellite connectivity and a host of capabilities built to
government users’ unique requirements.**

## Capabilities

Built with government users in mind, our solutions deliver resilient, flexible and scalable
alternatives for the U.S. government to complement its satellite resources cost-effectively,
anytime, anywhere, even in the world’s most remote regions.

[See What We Deliver][86]

## Missions

Our services are in government operations on major platforms and programs worldwide. We understand
the unique set of demands and challenges of each domain – including land, maritime, aviation and
space – and we build and deliver robust, flexible solutions that are interoperable with government
satellite resources.

[Mission Specific Solutions][87]

## Visit our FirstNet Site

Our website complements FirstNet.com and is a go-to source for all satellite communication products
and services that are available to FirstNet customers from Inmarsat Government, the exclusive
provider of satellite connectivity to the FirstNet community.

[Learn More About FirstNet][88]

## How to Buy

We make your purchasing experience easy and efficient: order directly from Inmarsat Government or
purchase through our wholesale partners.

[Purchase from Us][89] [Contact Our Wholesale Partners][90]

## Become a Terminal Manufacturer Partner

We constantly strive to identify and join forces with value add terminal manufacturers to develop
innovative hardware solutions built to government users requirements.

### Adaptable Space Platforms

ISISPACE delivers tailored satellite systems and platforms, carefully designed according to your
mission requirements. We offer complete solutions and customizable components with our
state-of-the-art platforms that adapt to diverse needs and environments. With global reach and
cutting-edge technology, we ensure your mission achieves excellence – whether it's Earth
observation, communication, or scientific exploration.

[ Learn more ][20]

### Powering Space Missions

ISISPACE powers global missions with advanced launch solutions and products, offering
precision-engineered separation systems. Fully customizable to fit any mission type, our products
ensure flawless deployment and robust operation. We offer 100% support with the integration and
operation, so you can launch your ambitions beyond the horizon.

meet the requirements of a distinct range of missions, either intended for educational purposes or
large-scale payload performance requirements.

##### Solar Panels

Explore our high-performance solar panels that are designed for small satellite missions. These
panels utilise space-grade GaAs triple-junction solar cells and are available in 1U to 16U CubeSat
sizes, accommodating various mission needs. They include coarse sun sensors and temperature sensors
and are manufactured according to space standards such as ECSS-E-20-08 and MIL-PRF-13830.

[ Learn More ][26]

##### Modular Electric Power System

Power up your mission with ISISPACE Modular Electrical Power System that is ideal for up to 3U+
platforms. It offers a modular architecture, dual communication interfaces, and reliable telemetry.
You can expand the storage with 45Wh per PBP or stackable for redundancy.

[ Learn More ][27]

##### Compact Electric Power System

Explore our advanced Compact Electrical Power System that is ideal for up to 3UXL CubeSats,
featuring GaN-FETs for efficient solar power conversion, MPPT, and integrated battery heating. Our
ICEPS is available in three variants, ensuring customised mission performance. Talk with our experts
to know about customisation options.

[ Learn More ][28]

##### S-Band Patch Antenna

S-band patch antenna is engineered by ISISPACE for the commercial S-band range (2200-2290 MHz). This
lightweight, compact passive antenna is expertly designed for seamless integration with CubeSat
platforms. It has a flight heritage since 2021.

[ Learn more ][29]

##### S-Band TMTC Antenna

ISISPACE S-band TMTC antenna is engineered for the commercial S-band uplink and downlink range
(2025‑2110 MHz and 2200-2290 MHz). This lightweight, compact passive antenna is expertly designed
for seamless integration with CubeSat platforms. It combines superior RF performance, structural
compatibility, and proven flight heritage to ensure mission success.

[ Learn More ][30]

##### GNSS Active Patch Antenna

GNSS Patch Antenna from ISISPACE combines compact design, low mass, and flight-proven reliability.
The antenna is mounted onto a Rogers PCB, ideal for high-frequency RF circuitry, ensuring lower
losses than traditional FR-4 PCBs. It is qualified for up to 15g quasi-static acceleration in all
axes.

[ Learn More ][31]

Additionally, the top face can accommodate solar panels, patch antennas and sensors, offering
further adaptability.

About Us

For more than three decades, PALS has delivered **mission-critical communication systems**, evolving
**from satellite broadcasting** pioneers to **hybrid network innovators** - mastering both advanced
SATCOM solutions and **DVB-T2 terrestrial** site integration. Today, we unify **SATCOM, LTE, and
MESH/COFDM technologies**—powering everything from **mobile field operations** to **LEO satellite
tracking**—for defense, government, and media sectors worldwide.

**Military-Grade Expertise**: Our products meet **strict military standards (MIL-STD)**, ensuring
ruggedized, secure, and customized solutions for the most demanding environments.

**End-to-End Integration**: From **earth station deployment, retrofitting, and relocation** to
turnkey broadcast hubs and mobile platforms, we bridge innovation with reliability.

**Global Agility**: With hubs in **Istanbul, Dubai, and the Netherlands**, PALS delivers seamless
connectivity—anywhere, anytime—transforming challenges into opportunities.

managed services.

corresponding detection.

Understanding the Starlink Coverage Area and Power Systems
][151]
Expanding the Horizon: Understanding the Starlink Coverage Area The global pursuit of seamless
connectivity has led to the rise of Low Earth Orbit LEO satellite constellations, with the starlink
coverage area expanding rapidly to reach the most remote corners of the Earth. Unlike traditional
geostationary satellites, these modern arrays provide high-speed, low-latency internet by
maintaining a dense network of satellites. To support such ambitious infrastructure, the industry
relies on cutting-edge power solutions, such as Gallium Arsenide GaAs solar arrays, which ensure
that satellites remain operational in the harsh environment of space.

Partner with the trusted satellite service provider to telecom operators, governments, and
enterprises for more than 55 years.

Our advanced Telesat Lightspeed Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network will help resolve some of
the world’s most complex communications challenges. This highly reliable and secure satellite
network will deliver guaranteed high performance globally. And it will support both commercial and
military Ka‑band services to ensure our customers can count on assured, secure, high-capacity
broadband wherever their operations take them.

# Track The Sky — Real-Time 3D Satellite Tracker

Track over 9,000 satellites in real time on an interactive 3D globe. Monitor [space stations][1],
[Starlink][2], [GPS][3], [weather satellites][4], and more with live orbital data updated every two
hours from CelesTrak.

## Satellite Categories
* **[Space Stations][5]** — ISS, CSS, and related objects (approximately 30 satellites)
* **[Starlink][6]** — SpaceX Starlink constellation (approximately 6,000 satellites)
* **[OneWeb][7]** — OneWeb broadband constellation (approximately 600 satellites)
* **[GPS][8]** — US GPS operational satellites (approximately 31 satellites)
* **[Galileo][9]** — European navigation satellites (approximately 28 satellites)
* **[GLONASS][10]** — Russian navigation satellites (approximately 24 satellites)
* **[BeiDou][11]** — Chinese navigation satellites (approximately 50 satellites)
* **[Weather][12]** — Weather observation satellites (approximately 50 satellites)
* **[NOAA][13]** — NOAA environmental satellites (approximately 20 satellites)
* **[GOES][14]** — Geostationary weather satellites (approximately 10 satellites)
* **Amateur Radio** — Ham radio satellites (approximately 100 satellites)
* **[Iridium NEXT][15]** — Iridium communications constellation (approximately 75 satellites)
* **[Geostationary][16]** — Geostationary orbit satellites (approximately 500 satellites)
* **[Science][17]** — Scientific research satellites (approximately 50 satellites)
* **All Active** — All active satellites (~9000) (approximately 9,000 satellites)

## Browse by Category
* [Space Station Tracker][18] — Track the International Space Station (ISS), China's Tiangong, and
  other crewed spacecraft in real time on a 3D globe with live orbital data.
* [Starlink Satellite Tracker][19] — Track SpaceX Starlink satellites in real time.
* [GPS Satellite Tracker][20] — Track US GPS satellites in real time on a 3D globe.
* [Weather Satellite Tracker][21] — Track NOAA, GOES, MetOp, and other weather satellites in real
  time.
* [Science Satellite Tracker][22] — Track Hubble, JWST, Terra, Aqua, and other science satellites in
  real time.
* [Military Satellite Tracker][23] — Track military and defense satellites in real time.
* [Space Debris Tracker][24] — Track orbital debris and defunct satellites in real time.
* [Communication Satellite Tracker][25] — Track Iridium, Intelsat, SES, and other communication
  satellites in real time.
* [Navigation Satellite Tracker][26] — Track GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and BeiDou navigation satellites
  in real time.
* [Earth Observation Satellite Tracker][27] — Track Landsat, Sentinel, and other Earth observation
  satellites in real time.

## Features
* Real-time satellite propagation using SGP4/SDP4 orbital mechanics
* Interactive 3D CesiumJS globe with Natural Earth textures
* Click any satellite to see its orbit path, ground track, altitude, and velocity
* Overhead pass predictions for your location
* Conjunction (close approach) alerts between tracked satellites
* Day/night solar illumination — see which satellites are sunlit or in shadow
* Search by satellite name or NORAD catalog number
* Time controls — pause, fast-forward at 10x, 60x, or 600x speed
* Camera follow mode to track a satellite across the globe
* Cinematic mode with bloom effects for screenshots and presentations
* Satellite footprint visualization showing ground coverage area
* Sky View polar plot showing satellites overhead your location with azimuth and elevation
* [ISS][28] Live View with real-time altitude, speed, sunlit status, and crew manifest
* Observer location support with geolocation, manual coordinates, and preset cities
* Browser push notifications for satellite pass alerts with 5-minute advance warning
* [Starlink][29] train detector identifying recently launched satellites still in orbit-raising
  phase
* Historical space events timeline with 15 curated milestones from 2007 to 2024
* Orbit comparison tool to compare up to 6 satellites side by side
* Discovery panel with Famous, Records, Recent, and Decaying satellite browsing tabs
* Fuzzy search spotlight with recent searches, keyboard navigation, and random satellite picker
* Reentry tracker showing decaying satellites ranked by estimated time to atmospheric re-entry
* Shareable satellite snapshot cards with downloadable branded PNG images
* Timelapse recorder capturing the CesiumJS globe as a downloadable WebM video
* Launch calendar with upcoming rocket launches, countdowns, and mission details
* Ground station network map showing 20 major tracking facilities worldwide
* Space debris and fragmentation event tracker with known collision and ASAT test data
* Naked eye visibility mode estimating visual magnitude for satellites overhead
* Multi-language support in English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and Chinese

## Mercados

Descubra cómo las comunicaciones por satélite permiten operar con seguridad y conectividad en zonas
remotas sin cobertura móvil. Ofrecemos soluciones para empresas, administraciones, ONG y

transporte, marítimo y  [organizaciones humanitarias][19] con operaciones globales.

incluso en zonas sin cobertura móvil. Operamos en más de 50 países y proyectos internacionales.

# VoIP Information & Help


## **Help solving your VoIP problems.**

** VoIP Mechanic is your information VoIP online resource about Voice over IP, with lots of help,
VoIP tutorials and how-tos about VoIP installation, troubleshooting common VoIP problems such as
echo, buzzing, dropped calls, one-way audio and problems with [faxing over VoIP][34].  We offer you
VoIP troubleshooting tutorials on how to identify and correct problems, in short we will help you
with VoIP.  **Whether you are researching about [getting VoIP][35], sell VoIP as a rep or reseller,
or are a current user, we will help correct most problems that you may experience with your VoIP
phone connection, including echo, choppy voice, one-way audio, faxing errors, and losing dial tone.
 We will give you the information to fix many of these annoying issues that you could experience
with your Voice over Internet phone service. ** **Whether or not you are familiar with VoIP we think
you will still find VoIPMechanic an easy to use online VoIP resource.**  **

### About

**Zoom Earth** is an interactive weather map of the world.

Explore the current weather and detailed forecasts for your location with stunning, interactive maps
showing rain, wind, temperature, pressure, and more.

With **Zoom Earth** you can track the development of hurricanes and storms, monitor wildfires and
smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery and rain radar updated
in near real time.

#### Mobile App

[[App]][1] [[QR]][2]

Download the [**Zoom Earth**][3] app!

**Scan the QR code** with the camera on your mobile device to get the **Zoom Earth** app.

Available on the [App Store][4] for iPhone and iPad, and on [Google Play][5] for Android.

#### Data Sources

Weather forecasts are continually updated with the latest global model data from DWD [ICON][6] and
NOAA/NCEP/NWS [GFS][7].

Radar data is processed in real time from many meteorological [sources][8] around the world.

Live satellite imagery is provided by [NOAA GOES][9], [EUMETSAT Meteosat][10], and [JMA
Himawari][11] geostationary satellites.

HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites [Aqua][12] and
[Terra][13], using services from [GIBS][14], part of [EOSDIS][15].

Tropical system tracks are generated using the latest data from [NHC][16], [JTWC][17], [NRL][18],
and [IBTrACS][19].

Active fire data is compiled from many sources, including [NIFC][20], [CIFFC][21], Australian fire
agencies, [Copernicus EMS][22], and [GDACS][23].

The heat spots overlay shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are
updated daily, not live, with data from NASA LANCE [FIRMS][24].

Map labels © [OpenStreetMap][25] contributors.

#### Contact

Please use our [contact form][26] to send us your comments, questions, or suggestions.

© 2026 Neave Interactive Ltd.

[Terms of Service][27]

[Privacy Policy][28]

### Heat Spots

Heat spots are **not live!** Detections are updated *daily* and are delayed by many hours.

Red spots show the *approximate* locations of very high temperature detected by satellite. These
spots may be from fire or other sources of heat such as *hot smoke* or *agriculture*.

Clouds may prevent the detection of heat.

**Do not** use for the preservation of life or property! Detections have limited accuracy. Always
refer to local authorities for the latest information.

Yes, I Understand

Track the weather in real time with the **Zoom Earth** app.
